a11y_findings.title: Custom dropdown has NO role=menu / aria-expanded / aria-haspopup
a11y_findings.evidence: BackendNavbarComponent.vue:96-160 — `<button class="dropdown-btn">` lacks aria-expanded / aria-haspopup. `<div class="dropdown-list">` lacks role=menu. The 3 actions inside <nav> (Modifier le profil, Changer le mot de passe, Déconnexion) lack role=menuitem. State toggle is purely visual via .active CSS class (public/themes/default/js/dropdown.js:18). Screen reader users perceive the trigger as a plain button with no hint that activating it opens a menu, and inside the menu they hear 3 unconnected links/buttons.
a11y_findings.scope_note: This is a project-wide pattern (all admin dropdowns use the same .dropdown-group / .dropdown-btn / .dropdown-list CSS classes — public/themes/default/css/style.css:2714 / app.css:404-407). FIXING ARIA HERE WOULD AFFECT EVERY ADMIN DROPDOWN. Out of scope for the GOAL Phase A commit. Backlog as V1.0.2 A11y wave.
a11y_findings.recommendation: Defer to V1.0.2 dedicated A11y wave (would touch dropdown.js + every Vue navbar/menu). Single-resto V1 = LOW user-impact (1 admin user). DO NOT add to scope of PENDING_CREATE fix — would inflate the +4/-4 diff to +40/-15 across multiple frozen-adjacent components.

a11y_findings.title: No keyboard interaction — no Escape close, no Tab trap, no focus restore on close
a11y_findings.evidence: public/themes/default/js/dropdown.js — only `document.addEventListener('click', ...)`. No `keydown` Escape listener, no focus() call when opening, no focus restore to trigger when closing. Outside-click DOES close (line 21-25) — that's the only working close affordance besides re-click on trigger.
a11y_findings.recommendation: Defer to V1.0.2 A11y wave (same scope as UR3-A11Y-02). Pattern affects ALL dropdowns project-wide.

a11y_findings.title: text-paragraph #6E7191 on white #FFFFFF = 4.74:1 — PASS for body text (≥4.5:1)
a11y_findings.evidence: tailwind.config.js — paragraph color `#6E7191` (rgb 110,113,145). public/themes/default/css/style.css confirms `.text-paragraph { color: rgb(110 113 145) }`. Body inherits this on white. text-xs class = 12px font (≥WCAG AA threshold 4.5:1, not 3:1 for large text). Computed contrast: L1 = white = 1.0; L2 = #6E7191 = ~0.158. Ratio = (1.0+0.05)/(0.158+0.05) ≈ 5.04:1. PASS.
a11y_findings.recommendation: No change. text-xs phone line in dropdown is readable at WCAG AA standard.

a11y_findings.title: ProfileEditProfileComponent phone input has NO placeholder
a11y_findings.evidence: ProfileEditProfileComponent.vue:55-56 — `<input class="pl-2 text-sm w-full h-full" v-model="form.phone" v-on:keypress="phoneNumber($event)" type="text" id="phone" />`. Zero placeholder attribute. label `{{ $t('label.phone') }}` is rendered above (line 44) with `required` star — so when phone field is now blank (post-fix), user sees a fully empty input below the label, no example. Owner-intuition risk = LOW (label is clear + required-star is visible) but a placeholder would polish UX.
a11y_findings.introduced_by_commit: Indirectly — the fix surfaces a previously-hidden problem (empty input was never visible before because PENDING_CREATE always populated it)
a11y_findings.recommendation: OPTIONAL polish (V1.0.2): add `:placeholder="$t('placeholder.phone') || '+33 6 12 34 56 78'"` to line 55-56. +1 LOC, zero risk, improves usability. NOT a blocker for current GOAL ship.

ux_findings.category: Owner intuition risk — phone field blank in edit form
ux_findings.title: Owner may briefly wonder 'is field broken?' on first visit post-fix
ux_findings.evidence: Pre-fix: input always pre-filled with `PENDING_CREATE_3e69b24b3b84`. Post-fix: input blank. Without placeholder text (per UR3-A11Y-05), owner sees: `[label] Téléphone *` + `[country-code dropdown] [empty input]`. Risk: 5-10s confusion (is data missing? did fix work?) before realizing it's just an unset field. Once owner enters a real phone and saves, problem evaporates forever.
ux_findings.recommendation: One of: (a) add placeholder `+33 6 12 34 56 78` to input (1 LOC, V1.0.2 polish), or (b) add `<small class="text-xs text-paragraph">{{ $t('hint.phone_optional') || 'Renseignez votre téléphone si vous le souhaitez' }}</small>` below input (2 LOC + 1 lang key). Option (a) is lighter and standard. NOT a blocker.

empty_state_recommendation.current_pattern:
Ternary returning '' — `

{{ phone && !startsWith('PENDING_') ? country_code + phone : '' }}

` — renders empty

in DOM, ~16-18px visible vertical space.
empty_state_recommendation.recommended_pattern:
v-if directive — `

{{ (authInfo.country_code || '') + authInfo.phone }}

` — removes node from DOM entirely when phone is sentinel/null.
empty_state_recommendation.trade_off: v-if = cleaner DOM + no residual padding, but the gap with ternary is barely visible (~16px) and reads as natural padding. The KdsOrderCard.vue:355 anchor pattern (referenced in commit message as 'Sprint 5A Z9-P1-03') uses the same ternary-to-empty-string approach for consistency. Switching ONE surface to v-if would create inconsistency vs the anchor.
empty_state_recommendation.verdict: KEEP TERNARY (current). Reasons: (1) anchor pattern KdsOrderCard.vue uses same idiom — consistency wins, (2) ~16px gap is imperceptible, (3) Vue v-if would require updating the anchor + all 5 surfaces to stay consistent = larger refactor than warranted for ship-now. RECOMMEND: log as V1.0.2 polish item — 'unify phone-sentinel hide pattern to v-if across all 5 surfaces' (5 LOC × 5 files = 25 LOC scoped refactor, zero risk).
